principal_findings: Literal Definition 6 agrees with pointwise DecidableMOP; later uniform TM implementation assertions remain an interpretive issue.
IdentifiableInLimit, ConditionTwo, and positive rate learner existence are semantic, not ordinary computation certificates.
Uniform ordinary family membership is a sufficient specialization and differs from individual decidability and arbitrary uniform oracle access.
Positive breadth branches encode oracle-relative constructions; ordinary sampler and uniform MOP guarantees need both computable family membership and computable tell-tale emission.
Theorem 3.3 gives a stronger exponential rate component while computation guarantees remain conditional; no blanket stronger/weaker conclusion is warranted.
uncertainties: Whether all source uses of computable/algorithm are relative to the granted language oracle.
Whether the source tell-tale oracle is arbitrary, ordinary effective, or effective relative to membership.
Whether MOP reductions intend uniform decider access despite the literal pointwise Definition 6.

freeze.method: Outputs chmod 0444 after final content verification; cryptographic hashes reported to parent.
